description: Matched 885-node input data, default tuning, 1600×1000 viewport, same wheel and 96-CSS-pixel middle-button gesture. Control rectangles were observed when TrackballControls.handleResize measured its canvas. The baseline client is 6c61f5d3; the direct candidate is the implementation in Turn 10. No runtime errors in either run.
finding: The retired wrapper initialized controls before resizing its renderer and did not call handleResize afterward. Its gesture therefore used the initial canvas dimensions. Preserve correct viewport normalization; the browser regression must use enough actual middle-button gestures to cross the unchanged 65-unit wheel limit. The test caps those attempts and retains its original assertions.
